items.title: Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1957-04-20
items.q: I gave the guitar to Matthew. He played guitar and I played bass.

ctx.x: I played all of them, but my regular instrument was the first was the banjo. Then my bass player wasn't doing so good, so I gave the guitar to Matthew. He played guitar and I played bass. Lewis.
Is that, this is not the same Matthews? Bill Matthews?
No, no, no. Lewis and Joe Matthews. Uh-huh.
